fato_historico: 1921: The Portuguese Prime Minister and several officials are murdered in the Bloody Night coup.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a gentle shift from past turbulence toward a serene horizon. Just as history reminds us that even after dark nights, clarity eventually emerges, you might find that releasing old grievances brings immense relief. Consider it a good time to stabilize your ambitions and plant seeds of peace, allowing your natural groundedness to transform any lingering chaos into pure potential.
frase_do_dia: After the stormiest night, the morning sun always reveals a path forward.
significado_numero: Represents the beautiful cycle of completion and new beginnings.
conselho: Trust your intuition and find solace in your ability to build something lasting.
